name: Insecure Output Handling
description: Model output is consumed by a downstream component without validation — rendered as markup, executed as a command, or trusted as a control signal — turning generated text into an exploit primitive.
differs: Distinguished from Unexpected Code Execution (T4.002): here the defect is the consumer trusting the output; there it is the execution boundary itself.
